title: Surface Area of a Circular Paraboloid Cap
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the surface area of the paraboloid z = x^2 + y^2 below the plane z = 4.

steps.title: Compute Area Element d sigma
steps.mathExpression: z_x = 2x, \quad z_y = 2y \implies d\sigma = \sqrt{1 + 4x^2 + 4y^2} \, dA = \sqrt{1 + 4r^2} \, r \, dr \, d\theta
steps.explanation: Evaluate partial derivatives and convert to polar coordinates.

steps.title: Set Up Limits and Integrate
steps.mathExpression: z = 4 \implies x^2 + y^2 = 4 \implies r = 2; \quad \text{Area} = \int_0^{2\pi} d\theta \int_0^2 \sqrt{1 + 4r^2} r \, dr

steps.title: Evaluate Using Substitution
steps.explanation: Integrate using power rule on u^(1/2).
